name: Liquid Fill
description: The second clip rises over the first like liquid filling a glass, its surface sloshing in waves, lit by a bright meniscus line, bending the picture just below it, with a few bubbles rising through it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the liquid rises toward (x right, y up)

params.name: amplitude
params.description: Height of the waves on the surface, in frame heights

params.name: waves
params.description: Number of waves across the frame

params.name: highlight
params.description: Color of the bright line along the surface and the rims of the bubbles (alpha: strength)

params.name: refraction
params.description: How much the second clip is bent just below the surface

params.name: bubbles
params.description: How many bubbles rise through the liquid
